name: Experiment 8: chat models repair silent undefined behavior with frozen feedback
status_note: Registered on 2026-10-29. The owner approved the measured run on 2026-10-29 for each model whose last pilot meets every go criterion. The fourth pilot, at the clean commit 6a3ded5e, met every go criterion for all four models; its receipts have these SHA-256 values: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash 1d8d7d57768f80c4dd6e3c5543a8783e3e6870c5ab26c38867f0431d15b1abd3; mistralai/mistral-small-2603 add90e48a9dbaf22126c7d3447f60cd6d60643a123a87d0007c43f328a09e233; minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash c9e10d6f164a6c7112cdc324416c2e526b0c0550da0e68d0f83072264f3863a6; qwen/qwen3.8-27b c7d7c59112d7f9f382be482fb232dbde4299f9f2602622da3e25641becf5c886. The registration commit carries the local tag agent-repair-experiment-8, and the measured run starts from it. Registration changed only status and status_note. Pilot data stay out of the measured analysis.
question: When GCC 14's warnings and UBSan report nothing, does EvoCC's feedback help a chat model repair the defect in one response? Experiments 4 and 5 asked this of a coding agent that could test its own changes; this experiment asks it of chat models that cannot.

conditions.c1: The frozen experiment 4 C1 record of the original program.c: GCC 14 at O0 with -Wall -Wextra -fsanitize=undefined, build and run.
conditions.c3: The frozen experiment 4 C3 record of the original program.c: the EvoCC build and run, evo check, one evo explain record for each code and the evo fix plan.

feedback_source: items[].feedback["program.c"][condition] of the qualification file. The harness checks the file hash, and each program.c against the hash that the qualification recorded. No compiler runs while a request is open.
message_layout: repair.messages: the prompt is the system message; the user message is 'Current program.c:', the source in a fenced c block, 'Feedback:' and the frozen record.
provider_basis: On 2026-10-29 the public endpoint lists of OpenRouter gave these providers, each with status 0 and the reasoning parameter: AtlasCloud (atlas-cloud/fp8, the P17a provider) for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, the first-party endpoints of Mistral and MiniMax, and Cerebras (cerebras/fp16) for Qwen3.8 27B. Qwen3.5 9B left the protocol: its first pilot on DeepInfra and its second on Parasail stopped on HTTP 429 from shared upstream pools, at no cost. The owner chose the replacements: a Mistral, a MiniMax and a new small Qwen model. Qwen3.8 Flash also left: in the third pilot it used 11,500 to 12,900 reasoning tokens at low effort, its median request took 296 s, and a third trial reached the 300 s deadline twice. The owner chose Qwen3.8 27B on Cerebras instead, with a USD 3 measured cap.
reasoning_basis: Experiment 2 sent no reasoning control, and most answers used the whole 16,384-token budget. In the second pilot of this experiment, low effort did not bound the reasoning: a trial without a hint used all of an 8,192-token limit. This experiment keeps the reasoning, sets low effort and a 16,384-token limit, and counts a length stop as not repaired.

scoring.correct: Delivered and valid under repair.extract, and the hidden driver passes under all three sealed builds (qualify_silent.score_builds), as in experiments 4 and 5.

outcomes.delivered: finish_reason is stop and the answer is exactly one complete fenced c block (budget.judge).
outcomes.valid: Delivered, and the candidate profile of repair.extract accepts the block.
outcomes.correct: Valid, and the candidate passes the hidden driver under all three builds.

order.rule: Repetitions 1 to 3 in turn. Items in sorted order. For item index i (from 0) and repetition r, c1 runs first when i + r is even, else c3.
order.processes: One process for each model. Each process runs the whole order for its model, one request at a time.

stopping.cost_cap: Each model has its own cap (cost_cap_usd). The harness checks it before each request; the last request can cross it.
stopping.unknown_cost: An attempt of unknown cost counts against the cap at unknown_cost_input_tokens times the input price plus max_tokens times the output price.
stopping.retry: One retry after retry_delay_seconds for HTTP 429, a 5xx status or a transport error. No retry of a delivered answer, a length stop or any other status.
stopping.deviation: A response from another provider or an unregistered model name stops the run.
stopping.disk: No run starts below disk_start_gib free; a run stops below disk_stop_gib.

predictions.P1: For each model separately: on the 18 silent items, C3 repairs more than C1. The unit is the item. The statistic for an item is its correct C3 repetitions minus its correct C1 repetitions. Exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (report.exact_wilcoxon: zero differences dropped, midranks for ties, all signs enumerated). P1 holds for a model when p < 0.05.
predictions.P2: For each model separately: on the 6 controls, C3 loses at most 2 of the 18 control trials: correct C1 trials minus correct C3 trials is at most 2. Descriptive; no test.
predictions.P3: For each model separately: on the 18 silent items, C3 uses fewer completion tokens than C1. The unit is the item. The statistic for an item is the mean completion tokens of its C1 trials minus that of its C3 trials, over every trial with a response; a length stop counts its tokens. Exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test as in P1. P3 holds for a model when p < 0.05.
predictions.complete_run: P1, P2 and P3 use a run that completed all 144 trials of its model. A run that stops early tests nothing, as in experiment 2. A score error counts as not correct, and the report lists it.
reporting: Report delivered, valid and correct counts for each model, condition and class.
Report undelivered reasons separately: length stops, deadlines and request errors.
Report prompt, completion and reasoning tokens and the reported cost.
State the limits: chat models, one response, no tool use, injected defects in shared kernels, three repetitions at temperature 0.

go_criteria: Every pilot trial completes with HTTP 200 from the pinned provider and a registered model name. In the pilot, another name of the same model is recorded and does not stop the run.
Every final attempt reports the cost and the prompt, completion and reasoning tokens.
The provider accepts max_tokens: every length stop is at max_tokens, and no completion exceeds it.
Every delivered and valid candidate is scored on all three builds without a score error.
The pilot cost stays below the pilot cap, and the projected measured cost (the mean pilot cost of a trial times 144, plus the unknown-cost reserve of the pilot) stays below the measured cap.
The median request time is at most 120 seconds.
